item.title: Attorney General Ellison releases Election Report Form for incidents of election intimidation, deceptive technology, or deep fakes
item.description:
Publication Date: October 20, 2026

Minnesotans encouraged to report any incidents in Minnesota that occur between September 18 and November 3
